    Good to know

    Questions, answered.

    How do I order?

    Add items to your cart, check out, and send the order on Telegram or WhatsApp. This demo does not process payments.

    Pickup or delivery?

    Choose either at checkout. Tax and the delivery fee are shown before you order.

    Can I customize my burger?

    Yes. Open any burger or chicken item to add extras and write special instructions.

    What about allergies?

    Mention them in the special instructions or message us before ordering. Replace this answer with your own allergen policy.
